conclusion: 今天的重点从“agent 会不会做事”转向“企业能不能把 agent 的动作边界管住”。GitHub 在 9 月 9 日集中推出 Copilot agent 企业托管权限、PR secret merge block、Code Quality 批量 agentic autofix、CodeQL 2.27.0 Linux ARM64 和 JetBrains 企业托管 sandbox；OpenAI 侧则在 SDK/release 线上继续补 key expiration、image-generation options、UnixLocal symlink race 修复和 Codex 0.154.0 稳定包。
excerpt: 2026-09-10 的重点是 agent 操作权限、PR secret 合并闸、批量 autofix、ARM64 CodeQL parity 和本地 sandbox 文件 API 加固。
白话说: 今天不是给 AI 员工发更多活，而是先给它配门禁卡、审批单和出厂安检。

signals.title: Enterprise managed permissions for GitHub Copilot agent operations
signals.author: GitHub Changelog / Allison
signals.summary: Enterprise administrators can centrally control Copilot agent shell commands, file reads/edits, and network domains as blocked, approval-required, or allowed operations.
signals.takeaway: 动作: Build an agent operation policy matrix across app, CLI, IDE, and Codex entry points.

signals.title: Remediate Code Quality findings with agentic autofix
signals.author: GitHub Changelog / Allison
signals.summary: Copilot can take up to 25 standard Code Quality findings, fix them on a branch, validate changes, and open a pull request.
signals.takeaway: 动作: Treat bulk autofix as PR generation; require review, tests, diff scope, and AI credit tracking.

signals.title: Block pull requests with exposed secrets from merging
signals.author: GitHub Changelog / Allison
signals.summary: Repository rulesets can block PR merges until secret scanning has completed and all PR-introduced secret alerts are resolved.
signals.takeaway: 动作: Enable PR-layer secret merge gates and verify completed-scan, open-alert, and bypass states.

signals.title: CodeQL 2.27.0 adds support for Linux ARM64
signals.author: GitHub Changelog / Allison
signals.summary: CodeQL CLI now runs natively on Linux ARM64 and adds Rust command-line injection detection plus expanded framework coverage.
signals.takeaway: 动作: Add ARM64 runner parity checks for CodeQL version, query packs, registry auth, and language baselines.

signals.title: Enterprise-managed sandbox in Copilot for JetBrains
signals.author: GitHub Changelog / Allison
signals.summary: Copilot for JetBrains can apply enterprise-managed sandbox policies for filesystem, network, proxy, developer tools, macOS Keychain, and diagnostics.
signals.takeaway: 动作: Read back JetBrains managed sandbox state and compare it with CLI and VS Code policy behavior.

signals.author: OpenAI Agents SDK contributors
signals.summary: Agents SDK 0.22.2 supports current image generation tool options, prevents UnixLocal file API symlink races, and resets compaction response chains after pop.
signals.takeaway: 动作: Add symlink-race and compaction-pop smoke tests before upgrading long-running local workflows.

knowledge.title: Agent Operation Policy Matrix
knowledge.label: AGENT POLICY
knowledge.body: 把 agent 的 shell、file read/edit、network domain、Keychain、developer tools 等动作按 deny/ask/allow 做成组织级矩阵。
knowledge.summary: 用组织级红黄绿灯管理 agent 可执行动作。
steps: 按入口列出 Copilot app、CLI、VS Code、JetBrains、Codex 的策略来源和生效范围。
按团队列出 deny、ask、allow，并标注是否可被用户设置覆盖。
每次策略变更后用新会话读回实际限制，并保存被阻断动作的小票。
knowledge.risk: 只靠个人 auto-approval 会让旧审批或本地设置绕过组织边界。

knowledge.title: PR Secret Merge Gate
knowledge.label: SECRET MERGE
knowledge.body: 在 PR 合并层要求 secret scanning 完成且新增 alerts 全部解决，补上 push protection 之外的最后一道闸。
knowledge.summary: PR 合并前必须证明新增秘密告警已清零。
steps: 在 repository / organization / enterprise ruleset 启用 require_secret_scanning_alert_resolution。
标注覆盖的 secret types、bypass 权限和适用分支。
用模拟 PR 验证 scan completed、open alerts、bypass 三种状态。
knowledge.risk: 只启用 push protection 会漏掉某些 PR 层、generic/custom pattern 或配置外路径。

knowledge.title: Bulk Autofix Review Queue
knowledge.label: AUTOFIX REVIEW
knowledge.body: 把 Copilot 批量修复 code quality findings 的结果统一进入待审 PR 队列，而不是直接关闭 backlog。
knowledge.summary: 批量修复只生成 PR，不能自动算验收完成。
steps: 每批最多 25 条 findings，记录 selection、branch、AI credits 和 owner。
要求 PR 展示测试、验证命令和涉及文件清单。
reviewer 按批次决定 merge、split、rerun 或 reject。
knowledge.risk: 批量修复会快速制造 PR，但 reviewer 不跟上会把技术债变成 review 债。

knowledge.title: ARM64 CodeQL Parity Gate
knowledge.label: CODEQL ARM
knowledge.body: 把 Linux ARM64 上的 CodeQL 原生执行纳入 code scanning parity，保证 runner 架构变化不降低扫描覆盖。
knowledge.summary: ARM64 runner 上的 CodeQL 也要验证规则包和认证一致。
steps: 记录 CodeQL CLI / bundle 版本、runner 架构和 GHES/github.com 环境。
验证 custom queries、packs、private registry config 和认证来源。
对 Rust、Java/Kotlin、C# 等新增/增强查询保存 baseline 差异。
knowledge.risk: 换成 ARM64 runner 后，如果 query pack 或私有认证失败，扫描可能静默降级。
